name: Koma
description: Koma is the Cosmos Serpent, a colossal creature of Kaldheim born in the Cosmos and banished there by the Skoti.

summary.text: Koma is the Cosmos Serpent, a colossal creature of Kaldheim born in the Cosmos and banished there by the Skoti.

bio.text: The Skoti banished and trapped Koma in the Cosmos, and Fynn was linked to it and carried one of its scales as a shield.

citations.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

bio.text: Fynn dreamed that the Cosmos Serpent would break its cage and swallow the light of Starnheim.

citations.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citations.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

bio.text: Koma tore into the sky above Starnheim and attacked it, and the Valkyries fought to drive it back.

citations.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

bio.text: Niko anchored javelins in Koma's skull to steer it toward an Omenpath, and it crashed through and fell out of Starnheim.

citations.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

bio.text: Tibalt later cut open a doorway to Starnheim with the Sword of the Realms and unleashed Koma on the Valkyries.

citations.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

bio.text: In the Battle for Kaldheim, Koma emerged from a new rift in the sky and dove into the Karfell rift.

citations.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.
"Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

status.text: As of the latest mention, Tyvar says Koma and the World Tree were lost to Phyrexian transformation.

citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Birgi joins Niko and Kjell, who explains Fynn's dream that the Cosmos Serpent will break its cage and swallow the light of Starnheim.
timeline.quote: The Cosmos Serpent will break its cage and the first thing it swallows will be the light.

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Koma tears into the sky above Starnheim from the Cosmos and the Valkyries panic.
timeline.quote: The creature solidified into a massive, armored eel, born from the interstices of the Cosmos itself.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Forty Valkyries take to the air, and Niko lands on Koma's neck to anchor a javelin at its skull.
timeline.quote: They slid down the last few feet of neck to bury their spear between the scales of Koma's skull.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Valkyries bait Koma while Niko's mirror traps hide their bodies, steering Koma along.
timeline.quote: The serpent's jaws clamped down on nothing but clouds.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko spots the right Omenpath, an open portal of flame and battle, and directs the last Valkyrie squad to draw Koma toward it.
timeline.quote: THERE!" Niko shouted, raising their left fist.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Koma crashes through the hole and falls out of Starnheim, and Niko is nearly pulled in.
timeline.quote: Koma's weight and momentum carried it the rest of the way down through the hole

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: With the Sword of the Realms, Tibalt cuts open a doorway to Starnheim and unleashes Koma on the Valkyries.
timeline.quote: he cut open a doorway to the home of the Valkyries, where the Cosmos Serpent could make up for lost time

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: A new rift opens in the sky and Koma, the Cosmos Serpent, emerges.
timeline.quote: Koma. The Cosmos Serpent.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Koma dives into the Karfell rift, and Valkyries pour out of its own rift to attack the demons.
timeline.quote: They slammed into the demons from above, feathered wings tangling with leather membrane

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya gives Halvar the Sword; as he begins the ritual, Koma emerges through a tear in the sky and glides into Karfell's rift, disrupting the undead flow.
timeline.quote: Kaya gave Halvar the Sword of the Realms, which he accepted solemnly.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko warns the Valkyries and helps drive Koma back through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Niko took charge and helped them to drive Koma back through the Omenpath it had entered.

citation.text: "Niko Aris", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the chaos instigated by Tibalt, Koma attacks Starnheim and Niko joins the valkyries in its defense.
timeline.quote: Starnheim was attacked by the the Cosmos serpent Koma and Niko joined a host of valkyries in defense of the realm.

citation.text: "Starnheim", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tyvar tells Zimone how he saw allies, Koma and the World Tree lost to Phyrexian transformation, and how he senses it to time his camouflage.
timeline.quote: Koma, who I had revered, whose favor I had sought, fell to that cruel transformation.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The gods imprison Koma, fearing he would devour the Cosmos.
timeline.quote: The gods imprisoned Koma, fearing he would eventually devour the Cosmos itself.

citation.text: Koma, World-Eater (Foundations, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Fynn challenges Koma to a rematch.
timeline.quote: Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost!

citation.text: Fynn, the Fangbearer (Foundations, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Niko warns the Valkyries about Koma; Avtyr accuses Niko of disrupting Kaldheim's balance, then Koma breaks through.
timeline.quote: especially Avtyr who accused Niko of disrupting Kaldheim's balance

citation.text: "Avtyr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko, Rytva and Avtyr use mirrors and illusions to redirect Koma back through the portals.
timeline.quote: They orchestrated a risky strategy involving mirrors and illusions

citation.text: "Avtyr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko and Avtyr drive Koma back through a closing portal, sacrificing the stability of Starnheim's dock.
timeline.quote: The climax saw Niko and Avtyr collaborating in a final, daring maneuver

citation.text: "Avtyr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko announces he will seek Starnheim to warn the Valkyries of Koma, backed by Orhaft and Fynn.
timeline.quote: a decision supported by both Orhaft and Fynn.

citation.text: "Kjell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Skoti overthrew the Einir gods and prohibited Koma from entering any realm.
timeline.quote: when the Skoti overthrew the Einir gods , they also prohibited the Cosmos Serpent they revered from entering any of the realms.

citation.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fynn stabbed Koma, and the serpent's poisonous blood turned Fynn's blood to poison.
timeline.quote: it turned his blood to poison as well.

citation.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt used the Sword of the Realms to open an Omenpath for Koma into Starnheim.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Tibalt used the Sword of the Realms and opened an Omenpath for Koma to enter the realm

citation.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Valkyries, helped by Niko Aris, repelled Koma from Starnheim.
timeline.quote: The Serpent was repelled from Starnheim by the Valkyries with the help of the planeswalker Niko Aris .

citation.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koma closed the Omenpath connecting Bretagard and Karfell, destroying several draugr.
timeline.quote: Koma was responsible for closing the Omenpath that connected the realms of Bretagard and Karfell

citation.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koma was compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion and killed by his rival Fynn.
timeline.quote: Koma was compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion and killed by his rival Fynn .

citation.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko warned the Valkyries about Koma; Koma then breached into Starnheim.
timeline.quote: Koma manifested, breaching through the fabric of reality itself

citation.text: "Rytva", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko, Rytva and Avtyr devised a plan using mirrors and illusions to redirect Koma through the portals.
timeline.quote: They orchestrated a risky strategy involving mirrors and illusions

citation.text: "Rytva", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko and Avtyr drove Koma back through a closing portal, sacrificing the stability of Starnheim's dock.
timeline.quote: drive Koma back through a closing portal, sacrificing the stability of Starnheim's dock

citation.text: "Rytva", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
